# cufflink

> cufflink is a free, open-source Windows app that reads any selected text aloud, fully offline. Select text in any program, press Ctrl+Alt+M, and it reads it out while lighting up each word. No account, no network, nothing leaves the computer.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cufflink.reddy.world/): what cufflink does, its keyboard shortcuts, the voices, and how to install it
- [Privacy policy](https://cufflink.reddy.world/privacy/): what cufflink stores, what it downloads, and what it never sends

## Elsewhere
